{
  "root_cause": "The navigation controller adds a keydown listener each time a new list is rendered, causing multiple listeners and stale focus state. When Enter is pressed, the outdated listener uses an incorrect currentFocus index, resulting in the wrong suggestion being selected.",
  "repair_strategy": "Ensure the keydown listener is attached only once by adding a guard flag (_navigationListenerAttached) on the config object. The listener is attached only when no custom navigation function is provided and the flag is not set.",
  "edits": [
    {
      "path": "src/controllers/navigationController.js",
      "sha256": "cb38337c041e8e0543c4f7b31666374956d6dc85011604e12ff127c9bf67ddde",
      "before": "  const navigate = config.resultsList.navigation || navigation;\n  /**\n   * @listens {keydown} Listens to all `keydown` events on the input field\n   **/\n  config.inputField.addEventListener(\"keydown\", navigate);\n}",
      "after": "  const navigate = config.resultsList.navigation || navigation;\n  /**\n   * @listens {keydown} Listens to all `keydown` events on the input field\n   **/\n  if (!config.resultsList.navigation && !config._navigationListenerAttached) {\n    config.inputField.addEventListener(\"keydown\", navigate);\n    config._navigationListenerAttached = true;\n  }\n}"
    ]
  ,
  "expected_accessibility_effect": "Keyboard navigation will correctly track focus and active descendant, ensuring that pressing Enter selects the currently highlighted suggestion.",
  "functional_risks": [
    "If a custom navigation function is provided, we skip attaching our listener; the custom function must manage its own listeners.",
    "The flag _navigationListenerAttached could theoretically clash with other code using the same property name, but this is unlikely given the limited scope."
  ],
  "verification_requirements": [
    "After typing 'b', pressing ArrowDown twice, typing 'l', pressing ArrowDown once, and pressing Enter, the input value must be 'Blackberry'.",
    "Repeatedly opening and closing the suggestion list must not accumulate multiple keydown listeners.",
    "If a custom navigation function is supplied via config.resultsList.navigation, it should continue to work as expected."
  ]
}
